Scorecard: 8 CONFIRMED, 3 PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED (F1-1, F3-2, F4-1), 0 REFUTED; F1-1 and F4-1 refuted as literally stated (TEST-half drift significantly negative and EOD attribution model-dependent; spy_gap exceeds the claimed |rho| ceiling in TEST but is DISC-absent and beta). Not verified within budget: the '36 rules' count and MC drift fit (F1), complete_bar_used (F3-2), volatility terciles (F5-1), vendor independence of the log's bars (F2-1), within-ticker control (F5-2).
